subject.title: [Bug]: Fallback model does not report progress correctly during long tasks

question: Should OpenClaw guarantee channel-visible intermediate progress parity across model fallback candidates, including cross-provider fallbacks with different streaming/tool behavior?
rationale: The source has several fallback and progress surfaces, and fixing this safely requires deciding whether degraded provider progress is allowed or whether core must normalize parity before adding a repair.

options.title: Guarantee Parity In Core
options.body: Treat fallback attempts as the same user-visible progress contract as primary attempts and fix the shared progress plumbing plus regression proof.

options.title: Document Provider Gaps
options.body: Only guarantee available diagnostic or typing progress when a fallback provider lacks streaming/tool-progress capability, and document the degraded mode.

options.title: Fold Into Durable Status Work
options.body: Track this under a broader channel status/progress contract so fallback visibility is handled with the same semantics as other long-running task status work.

recommendation.title: Guarantee Parity In Core
recommendation.body: Treat fallback attempts as the same user-visible progress contract as primary attempts and fix the shared progress plumbing plus regression proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the model fallback mechanism and is the strongest history signal for setting the fallback behavior contract.
